text: Good evening ma, please I am so sorry to be disturbing you at this hour. My granddaughter is 11 months and she has refused to sleep since, she will cry small then sit up again. She is otherwise fine o, playing even. Her teeth are coming, she is dribbling well well and putting everything inside her mouth, one cheek is red. I also saw some red spots on her legs and arms and my heart jumped, but it is the mosquitoes, we sat in the garden the whole afternoon and they are bumps like bites, I even saw two of the mosquitoes inside. Please is there anything I can give her for the teeth so she can rest? Thank you and sorry again.
